description: Source code for Bluetooth buffer management in Zephyr OS, including buffer pool definitions and retrieval functions.

methods.name: bt_buf_get_rx
methods.description: Retrieves a receive buffer of specified type with timeout.

methods.name: bt_buf_get_evt
methods.description: Retrieves an event buffer based on event type and discardable flag.

methods.name: bt_buf_get_evt_pool
methods.description: Returns the event buffer pool (unit test access).

methods.name: bt_buf_get_acl_in_pool
methods.description: Returns the ACL input buffer pool (unit test access).

methods.name: bt_buf_get_hci_rx_pool
methods.description: Returns the HCI receive buffer pool (unit test access).

methods.name: bt_buf_get_discardable_pool
methods.description: Returns the discardable buffer pool (unit test access).

methods.name: bt_buf_get_num_complete_pool
methods.description: Returns the number complete buffer pool (unit test access).
